mapper.select: select p.provider, p.providername, p.icon, a.id, a.userid, a.username, a.socialuserid, a.createddate, a.updateddate from mxk_socials_provider p left join mxk_socials_associate a on a.provider = p.provider and a.instid = p.instid and a.userid = #{id} where p.instid = #{instId} and p.status = 1 order by p.sortindex
